about_the_game:
💎 Take Your Banker Simulator Experience to the Next Level!

Face the challenges of the banking world not just with power, but with privilege. Gold Pack gives you exclusive advantages, cosmetic items, and luxury features not available in the standard edition, making your journey to build a financial empire even more prestigious.

✨ What’s Included in the Gold Pack:

  • Exclusive Gold-Plated Office Furniture: Decorate your bank with a look worthy of a true financial titan.

  • Luxury Vehicle Packs: Handle money transfers in style with premium vehicles.

  • Premium Character Outfits: Showcase your banker identity with powerful and prestigious looks.

  • Starting Capital Bonus: Get ahead with extra funds to make strategic investments.

  • Special Banknote Designs: Personalize the counterfeit money system and leave your mark on the financial world.

💰 With the Gold Pack, you won’t just manage a bank—you’ll live the luxury and prestige of the financial world.
Manage risks, enhance your reputation, and turn every detail of the game into a golden experience.

📈 Don’t just reach the top—shine at the top!

Get the GOLD PACK now and start your banking career with a golden advantage.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD FX 4350
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 @ 3,2 GHz (4 CPUs)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1060
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: Embark on a privileged journey in the world of banking! The Gold Pack includes gold-plated office furniture, luxury vehicles, premium outfits, special banknote designs, and a starting capital bonus. Don’t just reach the top – shine at the top!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Turkish, Ukrainian, Russian
